def _household_impact(data: HouseholdImpactRequest, requested: Optional[dict]=None) -> dict:
    key = json.dumps(data.model_dump(mode='json'), sort_keys=True)
    bound = definitions.definitions_for(requested or {}, household_impact.measure_ids())
    results = copy.deepcopy(_cached_household_impact(key))
    results['definitions'] = bound
    return results
